mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(band = 'hot'), 0) AS hot, COALESCE(SUM(band = 'warm'), 0) AS warm, COALESCE(SUM(band = 'cool'), 0) AS cool, COALESCE(SUM(band = 'cold'), 0) AS cold, COALESCE(SUM(cooling), 0) AS cooling FROM classified

SELECT id FROM classified
WHERE cooling = TRUE ORDER BY raw_weight <= #{model.coldRawWeight}, raw_weight, id
ORDER BY raw_weight DESC, id
LIMIT #{limit}
